env BOLERO_MODULE=on
env proxy=$BOLERO_PROXY
env BOLERO_PROXY=direct

# BOLERO_VCS stops bolero get
env BOLERO_VCS='*:none'
! bolero get github.com/google/go-cmp
stderr '^bolero: BOLERO_VCS disallows using git for public github.com/google/go-cmp; see ''bolero help vcs''$'
env BOLERO_PRIVATE='github.com/google'
! bolero get github.com/google/go-cmp
stderr '^bolero: BOLERO_VCS disallows using git for private github.com/google/go-cmp; see ''bolero help vcs''$'

# public pattern works
env BOLERO_PRIVATE='github.com/google'
env BOLERO_VCS='public:all,private:none'
! bolero get github.com/google/go-cmp
stderr '^bolero: BOLERO_VCS disallows using git for private github.com/google/go-cmp; see ''bolero help vcs''$'

# private pattern works
env BOLERO_PRIVATE='hubgit.com/google'
env BOLERO_VCS='private:all,public:none'
! bolero get github.com/google/go-cmp
stderr '^bolero: BOLERO_VCS disallows using git for public github.com/google/go-cmp; see ''bolero help vcs''$'

# other patterns work (for more patterns, see TestGOVCS)
env BOLERO_PRIVATE=
env BOLERO_VCS='github.com:svn|hg'
! bolero get github.com/google/go-cmp
stderr '^bolero: BOLERO_VCS disallows using git for public github.com/google/go-cmp; see ''bolero help vcs''$'
env BOLERO_VCS='github.com/google/go-cmp/inner:git,github.com:svn|hg'
! bolero get github.com/google/go-cmp
stderr '^bolero: BOLERO_VCS disallows using git for public github.com/google/go-cmp; see ''bolero help vcs''$'

# bad patterns are reported (for more bad patterns, see TestGOVCSErrors)
env BOLERO_VCS='git'
! bolero get github.com/google/go-cmp
stderr '^bolero: github.com/google/go-cmp: malformed entry in BOLERO_VCS \(missing colon\): "git"$'

env BOLERO_VCS=github.com:hg,github.com:git
! bolero get github.com/google/go-cmp
stderr '^bolero: github.com/google/go-cmp: unreachable pattern in BOLERO_VCS: "github.com:git" after "github.com:hg"$'

# bad BOLERO_VCS patterns do not stop commands that do not need to check VCS
bolero list
env BOLERO_PROXY=$proxy
bolero get rsc.io/quote # ok because used proxy
env BOLERO_PROXY=direct

# svn is disallowed by default
env BOLERO_PRIVATE=
env BOLERO_VCS=
! bolero get rsc.io/nonexist.svn/hello
stderr '^bolero: rsc.io/nonexist.svn/hello: BOLERO_VCS disallows using svn for public rsc.io/nonexist.svn; see ''bolero help vcs''$'

# fossil is disallowed by default
env BOLERO_PRIVATE=
env BOLERO_VCS=
! bolero get rsc.io/nonexist.fossil/hello
stderr '^bolero: rsc.io/nonexist.fossil/hello: BOLERO_VCS disallows using fossil for public rsc.io/nonexist.fossil; see ''bolero help vcs''$'

# bzr is disallowed by default
env BOLERO_PRIVATE=
env BOLERO_VCS=
! bolero get rsc.io/nonexist.bzr/hello
stderr '^bolero: rsc.io/nonexist.bzr/hello: BOLERO_VCS disallows using bzr for public rsc.io/nonexist.bzr; see ''bolero help vcs''$'

# git is OK by default
env BOLERO_VCS=
env BOLERO_NOSUMDB='*'
[net:rsc.io] [git] [!short] bolero get rsc.io/sampler

# hg is OK by default
env BOLERO_VCS=
env BOLERO_NOSUMDB='*'
[exec:hg] [!short] bolero get vcs-test.golang.org/go/custom-hg-hello

# git can be disallowed
env BOLERO_VCS=public:hg
! bolero get rsc.io/nonexist.git/hello
stderr '^bolero: rsc.io/nonexist.git/hello: BOLERO_VCS disallows using git for public rsc.io/nonexist.git; see ''bolero help vcs''$'

# hg can be disallowed
env BOLERO_VCS=public:git
! bolero get rsc.io/nonexist.hg/hello
stderr '^bolero: rsc.io/nonexist.hg/hello: BOLERO_VCS disallows using hg for public rsc.io/nonexist.hg; see ''bolero help vcs''$'

-- go.mod --
module m

-- p.go --
package p
